company_name: CHONGQING XINHUI MATERIALS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential materials such as polysilicon and quartz ware, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Chongqing Xinhui Materials Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of polysilicon and granular polycrystalline silicon, which are vital for semiconductor wafer fabrication. They also supply crystal growing materials and a variety of quartz ware products, including silicon carbide and fused quartz glass, supporting various semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Production of polysilicon and granular polycrystalline silicon
Manufacture of quartz ware products including silicon carbide and fused quartz glass
Provision of ceramic and oxide ceramic fixtures
